WHY — 'As seen in' + real quotes is fast social proof, lifts conversion.
TRADEOFF — needs real logos + permission; stays empty until you have coverage.

WHY — clients self-check open dates → far fewer back-and-forth emails.
TRADEOFF — needs a live data source (WordPress or cal.m1o.at) and upkeep.

WHY — turns a gallery into a story: deeper engagement + stronger SEO.
TRADEOFF — a short write-up and before/after assets per project.

WHY — answers 'what does it cost' before the email; filters serious enquiries.
TRADEOFF — commits you to numbers; you may prefer bespoke quotes.

WHY — one strong quote + a face builds trust in seconds.
TRADEOFF — needs a real client willing to be named and shown.
